title: Your Arrival Day in Arusha: What Happens
excerpt: What happens when you land at Kilimanjaro Airport? From passport control to your first night in Arusha.
body:
## Landing

Kilimanjaro International Airport lies between Moshi and Arusha.

## Passport and visa

Have your passport, visa and possibly yellow fever certificate ready.

## Luggage

Collect your luggage and go through customs.

## Welcome

The team of our partner waits for you with a name sign.

## Transfer

About an hour to Arusha.

## Briefing

At the lodge you get a short briefing about the trip.

## Rest

Rest, eat and sleep. Your safari starts the next morning.

## Late arrival

Many flights arrive in the evening; your lodge is prepared.

[Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
